title: Toddlers with Easter Baskets on Tricycle & Wagon, 1940s US Snapshot Photo
description: A charming post-WWII snapshot capturing two young toddlers playing on a sunny front lawn. The child on the left rides a classic metal tricycle while holding a woven Easter basket, and the boy on the right smiles from inside a miniature 'American Beauty' pull wagon, also holding an Easter basket. Parked along the residential street in the background is a late 1940s aerodynamic sedan alongside an earlier 1930s automobile, offering a classic glimpse of mid-century American suburban life.
